analysis.reasonEn: Attempting to rebound after a 3-day downtrend. RSI exited oversold but is at 53.4 in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. Volume ratio of 1.48 indicates increased conviction. Current price at 78.4% of 52-week high suggests upside potential, but confirmation needed at swing resistance of $272.29. ADX at 19.5 indicates a lack of trend. Waiting for trend confirmation.

[지지·저항 구조]

· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 방향성 부재
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 추세 전환 확인 시 매수 진입 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position vs SMA100/200($224.45/$175.52): Mid-to-long-term trend remains strong, above the 200-day MA.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation) + Consider buying on trend reversal confirmation.
